purpose: Queue the fourteenth and final currently-unqueued batch of still-uncovered C2 long-tail domains for source-specific promotion work. This artifact only selects candidate domains and web-checked sources; it does not complete Source Cards, fresh review, claim upgrade or calibrated model admission.

scope.selectionRule: Select the remaining C2 long-tail uncovered domains not already present in B1 through B13, preserving the Human Infra ordering by importance, long-horizon impact and fundamentality rather than near-term feasibility. The batch closes the current unqueued coverage gap across energy, vision, oral health, burns, genetic neurodegeneration, immunization proof, indoor/outdoor exposure, work-family continuity, court access, reproductive tissue traceability, skin supplies, substance exposure, synthetic data/media integrity and WIC redemption.
nonClaims: This queue does not complete Source Cards or reviewed artifacts for any B14 domain.
This queue does not complete independent fresh review or local source-context review.
This queue does not admit any domain into calibrated prediction, intervention ranking, clinical validity, individual advice or individual death-date output.
This queue does not modify the coverage register status; selected rows remain c2-longtail-uncovered until reviewed artifacts are created and separately audited.
This queue closes currently unqueued C2 long-tail coverage after B1/B2/B3/B4/B5/B6/B7/B8/B9/B10/B11/B12/B13 selection only; it does not close extraction, review or model-admission gaps.
This queue does not provide energy, medical, legal, court, reproductive, environmental, AI content, data governance, nutrition benefit or safety advice.
